summary: Read objectives and budgets from MCP and ChatGPT: fractal_slo_list and fractal_slo_history over a new read.assistant.slo scope

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema, index, or data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds the optional assistant scope read.assistant.slo and the assistant read projections GET /v1/client/assistant/slo and /v1/client/assistant/slo-history, admitted only for grants that hold the scope and authorized per read like every other assistant projection. slo pages the GET /v1/slo rows like the other assistant lists (cursor, limit, whole rows packed to max_response_bytes; a continuation expires when the ordered row IDs change) with only id, kind, account, about, target, current, window, remaining_percent, status, tone, reset/measured times and the budget forecast; explain, evidence, source, coverage, host and provider stay on the person surface. Budget rows carry the account digest id the person surface already shows. slo-history returns the GET /v1/slo/history shape plus kind. AssistantScope gains read.assistant.slo in the Rust, Swift and TypeScript clients; SloRow, SloList and SloHistory and the person routes are unchanged. The fractal-chatgpt/fractal-mcp adapter advertises thirteen tools.

downtime.detail: No added startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: Existing paired assistant grants do not gain the scope. The configured owning person re-grants on the grant-issuer member with every scope the grant should keep plus read.assistant.slo, e.g. fractal devices --as person/operator grant policy GRANT --scope read.assistant.summary --scope read.assistant.attention --scope read.assistant.missions --scope read.assistant.agents --scope read.assistant.conversation --scope read.assistant.slo --expires-in 30d --disclose-to-openai --consent-evidence EVIDENCE. Then restart or refresh the MCP client so tools/list shows the two tools.

recovery.detail: No state migration. Before rolling back, re-grant without read.assistant.slo so no grant names a scope the older daemon does not know.
